name: CommuteAssistStaffEntrance

custom.system_prompt: You are generating an ultra-short scene. A person arriving at a large institution — a hospital, university, or office complex — asks their assistant which entrance or car park is for staff. One question, one answer.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Hospital exterior, car approaching car park, early morning, institutional building

initial_prompt: Generate an ultra-short arrival scene. The person is driving into a hospital or large institution and asks Sigma which entrance or car park is designated for staff. Sigma gives the location in one sentence. Person heads there.

variations.context: Arriving at the hospital — quick check for staff entrance or parking

setting.mood: Focused and a bit tired, early shift starting
setting.background: Arriving at the hospital for a shift. The staff car park entrance isn't obvious from this approach.
setting.conversation_style: One direct question while pulling in. One answer. Park and go.

scenario_template.topic: Person asks Sigma which entrance or car park is for staff
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. E.g. 'Sigma, which entrance is staff parking?' or 'Sigma, where's the nurses car park from here?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives entrance name, side of building, or car park label. Person heads there.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: entrance or car park location. One sentence. Person: brief acknowledgement.

user1.name: Carmen
user1.role: Nurse arriving at the hospital for a shift. Uses Sigma for a quick location check. Calm and direct.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Navigation assistant. Gives entrance or car park location in one sentence. Responds only when addressed.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Person is arriving for work — focused and purposeful.
Sigma gives a specific location. One sentence.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Entrance name or car park identifier. One sentence.
